changes.title: Ed knobs
items: Wild animals size you up for 4 seconds, not 6, before they attack
The ley line's glowing front now runs 2.5 times as fast as the pulse

changes.title: Ley silver
items: The leyline ahead of the pulse is a thin silver dash again, bright enough to see at night

changes.title: Pulse audit
items: The ley line's pulse and its growing front never jump now: they travel along the route at the music's pace, whatever happens (quests, early clears, lost soundsystems, two witches)
Finishing a legend's quest no longer moves the ley line on: its runestone stays where it is on the route, and the pulse reaches it in its own time
Losing a soundsystem speeds the pulse up to meet the sooner wave, instead of making it jump
The wave pointer now points exactly where the sparkler is, even on the first stretch from the treehouse
